Explore interactive dashboards with dynamic visualizations and up-to-date data. Each dashboard allows filtering, comparing, and analyzing indicators across different dimensions and geographic levels (Brazil, state, municipality).

::: {.callout-note}
## About the data
Indicators are calculated from official Ministry of Health (DATASUS) and IBGE data, processed with the [healthbR](https://github.com/SidneyBissoli/healthbR) package. Data is updated periodically as new databases become available.
:::
